name: esp32_s3_touch_amoled_1_32
title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.32
description: A round 1.32-inch 466x466 AMOLED, CO5300 on QSPI, CST820 touch, ES8311 with a speaker header and a microphone; an ESP32-S3-PICO-1 with 8 MB flash and 8 MB octal PSRAM, a battery charger, PWR and BOOT buttons
notes: On a battery the board starts while PWR is held: the program sets GPIO18 (BAT_EN) high to keep the power on, and low turns the board off. On USB the power does not depend on GPIO18.
GPIO17 reads PWR through D2, low while it is pressed.
GPIO16 (Codec_EN) is EN of U3, the LDO of the codec, pulled up by R20: the codec is fed unless the program drives GPIO16 low.
USB-C goes to the chip itself, GPIO19 and 20 through 22 ohm: the log comes on the USB Serial/JTAG port. J1 brings the same D- and D+ out.
GPIO 33 to 37 are taken by the octal PSRAM inside the chip.

pins_vendor.notes: The same pins as the schematic; the touch at 0x15, the QSPI at 40 MHz.

chip.source: esptool on Anton's board: ESP32-S3-PICO-1 (LGA56) rev v0.2, 8 MB flash (XMC), 8 MB PSRAM (AP_3v3)

glass.by: the author of DGX, on this board
glass.notes: The CO5300 driver of DGX at 40 MHz, 16 bits, the reset on GPIO8, TE on GPIO9. Through this component it was not run yet.

touch_chip.source: the page of the board at docs.waveshare.com: a CO5300 and a CST820
touch_chip.notes: The schematic draws only the connector of the panel and names no chip.

picture.notes: hello_board through this component, DGX 0.12.13 from the registry, 16 bits: a white screen with a blue bar at the top.

sound.notes: hello_board through this component: the second of 441 Hz at 22050 Hz and volume 25 heard on a speaker at J6.

touch.by: a program of the bench through this component, the board in Anton's hand
touch.notes: The CST820 starts through esp_lcd_touch_cst816s 1.1.2 (IC id 183) and answers at 0x15. With the calibration of the data, 30 touches on the nine rings came out 14 pixels from the nearest ring on average and 33 at worst. With an identity calibration the point came out mirrored through the center: the panel lies turned by 180 degrees.

power.name: VSYS
power.why: Q1 passes VBAT while PWR is held or while GPIO18 (BAT_EN) holds T1 on; Q2 stops it while VBUS is there.

power.name: Codec_3V3
power.why: EN of U3 is Codec_EN on GPIO16, pulled up to VCC3V3 by R20.

lcd.notes: On P1, a board-to-board connector of 24 pins; VCI_EN of the panel is pulled up by R12. The size is the diameter of the round glass, 1.32 inches by Waveshare: the pixels span it, not measured.

calibrations.notes: Measured by a program of the bench, not by dgx_di_calibrate_measure, whose targets near the corners lie outside a round glass: one ring at a time, two rounds, each place the median of the two touches. The touch lies turned by 180 degrees under the glass. Turned back, a touch was 18 pixels off its ring on average and 27.5 at worst.

touch.notes: On P1 with the panel. The I2C has 10K to VCC3V3, R32 and R33.

notes: CE of the codec is held low through R19, so its address is 0x18. PA_CTRL reaches CTRL of the NS4150B through R29, 0 ohm, and R31 holds it low.
MIC1 is on MIC1P of the codec: ASDOUT comes in on GPIO40. Only the output is set up.

usb.notes: D- and D+ of Type_C1 go to the USB Serial/JTAG of the chip, the console and the flashing.

mic.notes: The schematic gives no part number.

charger.notes: It charges the battery from VBUS; R4, 82K, sets the current to 2 A by the table of the schematic.
